name: project_review
description: Review code/PR against claude-wrapper project standards.
prompt:
Review the following code/changes against claude-wrapper standards:

STANDARDS (from CLAUDE.md):
- Rust 2024 edition
- MSRV 1.90
- thiserror for library errors, anyhow for app errors
- ALL public APIs have doc comments (required)
- cargo fmt applied
- Conventional commits: feat/fix/docs/refactor/test/chore
- Branch naming: fix/, feat/, docs/, refactor/, test/
- No backward-compat hacks or unused code
- Builder pattern for CLIs and command APIs
- Typed outputs over stringly-typed

WORKSPACE CONTEXT:
- claude-pool: core skill/slot system
- claude-pool-server: MCP server exposing pool
- claude-wrapper: CLI wrapper library
- Dependencies: pool -> pool-server, both used by wrapper

Review thoroughly for:
- Missing doc comments on public items
- Unconventional error handling
- Style/formatting issues
- Breaking changes without ! marker
- Architecture misalignment

{target}

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: Code diff, file path, or PR # to review.
